instructions:
Carbonara is a node-based factory planner for automation games. A document is a factory: a graph of recipe nodes (machines running a recipe), sources (raw inputs), sinks (targets) and junctions, connected by edges that each carry one item. Carbonara solves every document for the rates of every edge and the number of machines of every node.

Tools take a documentId; "active" names the document on screen. Rates in results are items per second. Read tools are always allowed. Planning, editing and pack authoring tools only work once the person allows them in Carbonara (AI access); if a tool is refused, ask them to switch its group on. Every edit is one undoable step in the document's history, shown as "AI: <label>".

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List the factory documents open in Carbonara: id, name, game pack and version.

tools.name: get_graph
tools.description: A document's graph: its nodes (recipes, sources, sinks, junctions …), the edges between them and the nodes' positions. Large graphs come back summarised: node counts per recipe and item instead of every node.

documentId.description: The document's id from list_documents, or "active" for the document on screen in Carbonara.

tools.name: edit_graph
tools.description: Change a document with a batch of commands: add nodes, connect them, set node fields, rates and pins, move, disconnect or remove nodes. The whole batch is one step in the undo history; give it a short label saying what it does, such as "Add steel smelting". Nodes connect by item; recipe nodes take recipe ids from get_pack_data. Positions are canvas pixels: lay nodes out left to right along the flow, about 320 apart. Answers the document's new version, or the problems that stopped the batch.

documentId.description: The document's id from list_documents, or "active" for the document on screen in Carbonara.

id.description: Chosen by the manager when left out.

building.description: One of the recipe's buildings; the recipe's first when left out.

fields.description: Values of the pack plugin's node fields.

maxPerSecond.description: Most this source supplies; unlimited when left out.

kind.description: Splits and merges flows: splitters, mergers, buses.

collapsed.description: Folded to its label bar: the canvas hides the nodes it holds and draws their flows to the bar.

locked.description: Locked nodes stay put: dragging, nudging and arranging leave them.

tag.description: A colour tag the user gave the node.

flow.description: Flows enter the node at the top and leave at the bottom, as arranging top to bottom leaves them; on the left and right when left out.

logistics.description: Belt or pipe tier; limits the flow to its capacity.

ratio.description: Fixed share of the source node's output of this item.

locked.description: Locked nodes stay put: dragging, nudging and arranging leave them.

tag.description: A colour tag the user gave the node.

flow.description: Flows enter the node at the top and leave at the bottom, as arranging top to bottom leaves them; on the left and right when left out.

settings.description: Merged into the document's `settings.plugin` (the save profile); null removes a setting.

perSecond.description: A source's supply limit or a sink's target, in items per second; null removes it.

building.description: The building to run it in; the recipe's first when left out.

oneOf.description: Changes the recipe of recipe nodes; their fields and pins stay. Flows the recipe can't take aren't removed.
Changes a note's text or a frame's label.
Gives nodes a colour tag (on their position), or removes it.

logistics.description: The belt or pipe tier; null leaves the flow unlimited.

oneOf.description: Sets the belt or pipe tier of flows.
Changes the document's display settings; null puts one back to its default, a missing one stays.
Removes nodes and keeps the flow connected: each flow that went into them is connected to each that came out of them with the same item. New flows are named after the two they join (`in+out`).
Locks nodes in place (dragging, nudging and arranging leave them), or unlocks them.
Folds frames to their label bar, hiding the nodes they hold on the canvas, or unfolds them.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last change to a document.

documentId.description: The document's id from list_documents, or "active" for the document on screen in Carbonara.

tools.name: get_totals
tools.description: Totals of a solved document: raw inputs by item (items per second) and buildings by building id. Null while the document isn't solved.

documentId.description: The document's id from list_documents, or "active" for the document on screen in Carbonara.

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.description: Problems of a solved document: deficits, surpluses (byproducts), overflowing belts and pipes, missed pins and errors, with rates in items per second. An empty list means the factory runs as planned.

documentId.description: The document's id from list_documents, or "active" for the document on screen in Carbonara.

tools.name: plan_production
tools.description: Plan a production chain that makes the target items at the given rates (items per second) with the document's pack, using as few raw resources (or buildings) as possible. Returns a proposal: the nodes and flows to add next to the existing factory, a summary (buildings, raw inputs, byproducts, power) and anything that can't be met. Nothing changes until the proposal's commands are applied.

documentId.description: The document's id from list_documents, or "active" for the document on screen in Carbonara.

objective.description: What to use as little of: raw resources, or buildings.

alternates.description: Whether alternate recipes may be used.

exclude.description: Recipes the plan must not use.

tools.name: compare_recipes
tools.description: Compare the recipes that make an item: plan the item at the given rate (items per second) once with each recipe and report each plan's buildings, raw inputs, byproducts and power, best first.

documentId.description: The document's id from list_documents, or "active" for the document on screen in Carbonara.

objective.description: What to use as little of: raw resources, or buildings.

alternates.description: Whether alternate recipes may be used.

exclude.description: Recipes the plan must not use.

tools.name: get_pack_data
tools.description: A game pack's data: items, recipes (inputs and outputs per craft, seconds per craft, buildings), buildings, logistics (belt and pipe capacities, in the pack's rate unit) and raw resources.

resources.description: JSON Schema of a pack's data/*.yaml files.

prompts.name: design_production_line
prompts.description: Design a production line for an item and a rate in the document on screen.

arguments.name: item
arguments.description: What to make, such as steel plate.

arguments.name: rate
arguments.description: How much, such as "2 full yellow belts" or "60 per minute".

prompts.text:
Design a production line in Carbonara that makes {{item}} at {{rate}}.

1. Work in the document on screen (documentId "active") unless I name another one. Read its game pack with get_pack_data: the item, the recipes that make it and, if the rate is given in belts, the belt's capacity (logistics, in the pack's rate unit).
2. Convert the rate to items per second.
3. If plan_production is available, plan with it and show me the proposal. Otherwise build the line with one edit_graph batch: a sink with the target rate, a recipe node for each step, sources for the raw inputs, and edges between them. Label the batch.
4. Check get_diagnostics and fix any deficit. Then report get_totals: machines per building and raw inputs.

prompts.name: create_pack
prompts.description: Create a Carbonara game pack for a game.

arguments.name: game
arguments.description: The game the pack is for.

prompts.text:
Help me create a Carbonara game pack for {{game}}.

Read the resources carbonara://schemas/pack-manifest.json, carbonara://schemas/pack-data.json and carbonara://docs/plugin-api.ts first. A pack is a folder with a manifest.yaml, data/*.yaml files (items, buildings, recipes, logistics, resources) and, for rules the data can't express, a plugin/index.ts. Take the numbers from the game's own data, and use no assets the game's publisher hasn't allowed. Write the files for me, then have me run `pnpm carbonara-pack validate <folder>` and fix what it reports.
